Speaker: Venn
Text: Ashcroft's student? No, no — her research partner. Ah, you must be Kael. She mentioned you in her notes.

Speaker: Kael
Text: I need the Harmonic Crystal. I know you have it.

Speaker: Venn
Text: Direct. I like that. Yes, I have it — and I'll give it to you. On one condition.

Speaker: Venn
Text: Let me come along. I've spent decades studying the Rift from this side. I need to see it from the other.
